'''Teresia''' was a [[Queen]] of [[Ghealdan]]. She is young and pretty.

==Activities==
She succeeded [[Ellizelle]] and preceded [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]]. Her reign lasted only ten days. She sent two thousand of her soldiers against an audience of ten thousand people gathered to listen to [[Masema]]. The soldiers were routed. She then married the merchant [[Beron Goerad]], who may have been coerced into doing so. Being married to a commoner rendered her ineligible for the throne, and Alliandre was crowned that same morning.

{{quote|Whatever Beron Goraed feels about having a pretty young wife with royal blood, I hear he was dragged from his bed by a score of Alliandre’s retainers and hauled to Jheda Palace for a wedding in the small hours of the morning.|[[Ragan]]{{ref/book|5|39}}}}

If she is still alive, she likely still lives on her husband's country estates.
